label: Diagram 15
caption: Diagram 15 Bends in flues | Inspection and cleaning openings in flues
description: Diagram 15, titled "Bends in flues", shows two parts. On the left, a flue is drawn in section as two parallel vertical lines curving into an S shape. The top bend is marked with an arc, a dashed centreline and the figure "45°", with the label "Angle should not be more than 45°" pointing to it. The middle straight section is labelled "Offset", and the two curves are labelled "Bends"; the lower bend is also marked with an arc, a dashed centreline and "45°". On the right, two rectangular appliance outlines are stacked. The upper one has a flue leaving its right side, running horizontally then bending upwards; an arrow labels this "90° bend not suitable for solid fuel appliances", with "= 2 x 45°" beside it. A horizontal dimension between two extension lines reads "Maximum 150mm horizontal section from back outlet of appliance". The lower rectangle has a flue leaving right then bending up, labelled "90° with cleaning access".
